overview_description.description:
Latchel provides an operations platform intended to track maintenance and vendor selection. The company's platform provides maintenance tracking and vendor selection services by property management companies to track maintenance requests, increase net margins, and increase renter satisfaction via mobile application, enabling users to connect automatically with the tenants.

Latchel was founded on 2016 and is based in Seattle, Washington.

about_short_description.short_description: Latchel provides a property management software that helps streamline maintenance and work orders.

product.name: Latchel Maintenance Support
product.description: A property maintenance software platform that automates and manages maintenance requests, troubleshooting, and vendor coordination for property managers.

product.name: Latchel Resident Benefits
product.description: A suite of resident-focused services including damage reimbursements, housekeeping credits, pest control, air filter delivery, and rewards programs to enhance resident experience.

product.name: RentCheck Property Inspection Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and organizes property inspections, enabling residents to self-complete inspections and submit maintenance requests directly.

product.name: Sure Renter's Insurance Program
product.description: A tailored renter’s insurance program offered through a partnership with Sure, providing property managers and residents with insurance options to protect assets and minimize risk.

product.name: Cover Pest Affordable Pest Control
product.description: A pest control service accessible to residents without additional cost, handling vendor sourcing and coordination for pest issues.

product.name: FilterTime Air Filter Delivery Subscription
product.description: A subscription service delivering air filters to residents to facilitate timely HVAC maintenance and reduce repair costs.
